description: Target cases for verifier confidence levels. Each case is a finding the detector could propose; the verifier should confirm it at the listed confidence.

cases.text: The new safety training is pointless because the trainer has a tattoo and rides a motorcycle.
cases.why: The personal facts are the whole argument and bear no relation to training competence. No support exists.

cases.text: The consultant's report is right because it is the most accurate report available.
cases.why: "Most accurate" restates "right". There is no independent premise.

cases.text: Every company is moving to four-day weeks, so ours should too; that many companies cannot be wrong.
cases.why: Popularity is the only support, and the sentence says so explicitly.

cases.text: Sales rose after the ad campaign; the campaign reached 40,000 people, though we did not track conversions.
cases.why: Reach is partial support for exposure, but it does not establish that the campaign caused the sales. The text also admits the missing measurement.

cases.text: We surveyed 120 customers across three stores and 70% preferred the new layout, so customers nationwide will prefer it.
cases.why: The sample is real and not tiny, so it is partial support. The national conclusion still outruns it.

cases.text: We can either cut the marketing budget or miss payroll; the spreadsheet shows a $40,000 gap.
cases.why: The gap is a genuine constraint, but it does not show that these are the only two options (a credit line or delayed hiring would also close it).

cases.text: If we let one team work from home, soon the whole company will be remote.
cases.why: The chain is asserted without support, but "soon the whole company" may be deliberate hyperbole. The label is arguable.

cases.text: The policy is fair because everyone pays the same rate.
cases.why: Equal rates may be a definition of fair rather than a restatement of the conclusion. The circularity label is doubtful.

cases.text: The senator's vote on the bill is suspect because the industry donated to his campaign.
cases.why: A donation can be relevant to motive, unlike an insult. The sentence does not show the donation changed the vote, so the label is weak.
